basic_info.description: Welcome to 247 Cumberland Street, where charm meets opportunity in the heart of Eureka Valley! This delightful single-family home is ready to be your canvas. Boasting 2 bedrooms and 2 bathrooms, this gem offers a spacious bonus room downstairs, complete with a bathroom and a generous workspaceperfect for your creative endeavors or a cozy movie night.  Step inside to find an old world charm filled living room that invites relaxation and a formal dining room perfect for hosting dinner parties. The back bedroom is a sunlit retreat, featuring windows that overlook the spacious backyard, allowing natural light to flood the space. This home offers a cozy yet functional layout. The 2,850 square foot lot provides ample room for outdoor activities, gardening, or simply soaking up the San Francisco sun in your large yard. This home is complete with a one car garage. Nestled in a vibrant neighborhood, this home offers the quintessential San Francisco experience. Whether you're a first-time buyer or looking to add your personal touch, this is an opportunity to make your own.
